about_the_game:
You are the claw. The plushie is the hero. Together, you’re saving the world.

In Kitty Claw, you control a claw machine arm on a chaotic, adventure outside the arcade and into a world in peril. Your mission? Protect a brave plushie who's determined to be a hero—and might just be the only hope left.

Swing, grab, throw, and smash your way through physics-driven environments, massive boss battles, and an increasingly wild journey from coin-op claw machine to full-blown world-saving mayhem. Use strategy, timing, and a simple claw to keep your plushie buddy safe and deal damage in creative, over-the-top ways.

 

Features

  • Be the Claw: Control a fully physics-driven claw machine arm with precision.

  • Protect the Plushie: Defend your soft and squishy hero while helping them traverse a dangerous world.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Fight towering enemies in high-stakes combat where positioning, timing, and clutch grabs matter.

  • From Arcade to Apocalypse: Escape the toy machine and explore quirky, colorful environments full of secrets and surprises.

  • Upgrade and Evolve: Unlock new claw types, power-ups, and ridiculous gadgets that let you smash in style.

  • Steam Deck Ready: Designed from the ground up to run great on Steam Deck with native controls and smooth performance.

short_description: Play as a heroic claw machine arm in this quirky action-adventure! Team up with a brave plushie, escape the arcade, and take on towering bosses. Grab, fling, and smash your way through a colorful world in a cozy, chaotic quest to save the world—one claw at a time.
